title: Brazilian Ciabatta Sandwich
description: A delicious sandwich inspired by Brazilian flavors, made with grilled ciabatta bread and a variety of tasty ingredients.

ingredients.name: Brazilian-style grilled chicken
ingredients.notes: Grilled to an internal temperature of 165°F

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the ciabatta bread in half and toast until lightly browned.
Spread the yeasty cheese spread on the bottom half of the bread.
Add the grilled chicken, caramelized onions, tomato slices, and chopped cilantro on top of the cheese spread.
Drizzle with mayo and top with the other half of the bread.
Cut the sandwich in half and serve immediately.
